description: Show why one file is in the TypeScript program: the shortest import chain from a configured root and the direct importers. It reads the import graph only and does not run the type checker, so it finishes in seconds.

file.description: File to explain, relative to the tsconfig directory.

project.description: Absolute path to a directory with a tsconfig.json, or to a tsconfig file.

typescript.description: Path to a typescript package directory to use instead of the one in the project (5.x, 6.x or 7.x).
